About

A farm that keeps Sicilian flavours alive.

Agrumea Farm is the agricultural estate of Sebastiano Piazza, a family that has chosen to keep working the land the honest way: growing citrus fruits, almonds, pistachios and vegetables, then transforming them by hand into jams, pestos and preserves with an authentic flavour.

Every jar carries the story of our orchards — a small piece of Sicily, cooked slowly and shared generously.
